༄༅// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i chos ldan sa 'dzin sogs bsngags 'os rnams la phul ba'i zhu yig rnams yod// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta phreng ldan mar prāstā ra chig 1024 stong nyer bzhi yod pa'i nang gses/ naṣ+ṭa gser ldan ma/ ud+diṣ+ṭa brgya phrag rjes 179 'brangs bcas/ yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba phyogs kyi 10 grangs rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo chig khri rjes 15360 'brangs bcas/ lci yang lnga stong rjes 5120 'brangs bcas/ yi ge chig khri rjes 10240 'brangs bcas/ a dh+wa 'phred bcu dgu/ steng 'og nyis stong rjes 2047 'brangs dang bcas pas mdzes par spud pa'o// ༄༅// sar+b+badzinānāṃkar+m+makaṣaṣ+yādh+watrabhagam+māyā pratirūpaiḥnāyakasam+margāṅgatisaukhyaḥpaṃlayasats+tshīmāṃguruṇātwaṃ// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las snyigs ma yi// dus 'dir skal bar mthun pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// yang dag lam nas 'gro ba bder 'dren pa// dpal ldan bla ma dam pas khyed la srungs// gang dag blo gros 'phyang mo nyug gi khyogs la brten min skyabs kyi yang rtse nyer bzung na// mkhyen dang brtse ba nus pa'i pha rol chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa nyid du rab song bas// 'khor 'das shis pa'i dngos po kun gyis mngon par 'dod pa'i shing rta phyur bur 'geng ba la// gzhar yang bslu min bden dpang gyur pa dkon mchog gsum gyis 'di na legs pa'i dpal kun stsol// ye shes snang ba dam pa'i mig bgrad khro bo'i tshogs rnams bar chad srung ba'i gur khyim phubs// byi ru'i lhun po'i mdzes sdug zums byed bde ldan mgon gyis 'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog bskur// rigs byed lus phra mngon 'dod rgyal po mche ba gcig pas skye 'gro dbang du 'dun gyis la// 'di na dpal ldan mi yi dbang phyug sa stengs dge legs 'gugs pa'i grogs su zhabs brtan mdzod// las shugs btsan po'i 'khor los sngon 'gro mnga' thang phun tshogs 'dod 'byung nor bus lag pa brel// lugs brgya dpyod pa'i shes rab ri dwags mig can gyis 'khyud thabs kyi blon po rin chen sgrin// phun tshogs stobs kyi sa srungs rab brling phrin las kun du bgrod pa'i cang shes gom stabs bde// sgyu rtsal drug cu'i rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs dmag dpon dang ldan mi yi lha khyod bsngags pa'i 'os// skye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams chu yi gter// smon lam sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa'i bcud// mkhyen brtse rmad byung zla ba gzhon nu gang*// bstan srid bde 'byung ral par cis mi mdzes// gangs ri'i do shal 'chang ba'i yul ljongs kyi// bdag po mchog de gnam du gshegs pa'i rjes// 'gro 'dis bsod nams mang du bsags min na// lha khyod gnam gyi mthongs nas ci ste bab// gtong phod mi dman yal ga ring brkyangs nas// 'dod ldan skye bo'i re ba yongs skong zhing*// grib bsil ris med g.yo ba'i dpag bsam gyi// rkang 'thung 'di yod skal ba mi chung grang*// bde 'byor yul la ya mtshan ldan mthong tshe// mig stong ldan pas sum rtsen dga' tshal du// rnam par 'khrul te rtse dga'i ro myang phyir// dbus gyur 'chang gi ljongs 'dir lhags sam snyam// thos pa'i rna ba yangs pa 'dus pa'i dbus// ngo mtshar gtam gyi bdud rtsi mang 'jo ba// dpal ldan dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud mangs las// 'bab pa glu yi dum bu brkus gyis dogs// skyes sbyangs blo gros shel gyi rtsig logs su// gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'bod grogs gzugs bkra ba'i// khyad par ji bzhin dpyod la mdzangs ldan gyi// añja na bu min pa su zhig rtogs// sngon byung bod rje rgyal po'i sras rnams kyi// bzang spyod rmad byung gser ldan dkyil 'khor dag

/lhag bsam phrag par 'degs la mi ngal ba'i// snying stobs mi dman rnam gnon 'jug pa'i stobs// dpag bsam yongs 'dus bskyed pa'i dbul phongs dang*// kun phan gzhon nus spros pa'i dug bzhin du// chos ldan rgyal po khyod bsrungs sa phyogs su// dus ngan bskal pa mi srid las dbang shugs// rin chen gdub sil snyan pa'i glur 'jo bas// mdzes byas zhabs kyi chu skyes mi 'gyur ba'i// rkang stegs phyogs kyi mi bdag bye ba yi// mgo bos lan brgyar btud pa de drung du// mdo smad sa yi thig le sde bzhi dang*// dge bcu'i ming gis mtshon pa'i yul gru nas// sa skyong ljon pa'i rigs kyi yal ga ni// lang tsho dang po'i lcug phran gyur pa des// snyan dngags smra ba yongs kyis bsngags 'os der// daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung gi chu skyes bcud 'thungs pas// yid kyi bung ba rab dga'i 'phur ldeng dbyangs// cung zad blangs 'dis mkhas rnams mi dgyes med// ces pa'i shis brjod nyung ngus sngun bsu ba'i skabs kyi gleng ba/ ji ltar 'tsham pa bri'o// sa'i steng na mtshungs pa med pa dpal mi'i dbang phyug chen po/ 'gro ba yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag nyid du phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyir shis par brjod cing cung zad bsngags pa'i me tog man+dā ra ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa'o// // ༄༅// srid zhi'i shes pa kun gyi 'byung gnas che// che mchog yon tan zab rgya mkha' dang mtshungs// mtshungs med skyabs mchog gsum gyis legs pa'i dpal// dpal ldan mi bdag rnam par rgyal phyir stsol// bsod mtha' dag gzugs can/ nams gser gyi sgo nga'i sbubs yangs nas// legs par bltams pa sde bzhi'i gdong mdzes can// sa skyong sdom brtson 'jig rten spyi'i mes po// gtsug lag rig byed 'byin pa'i dbang phyug gang*// ga dza

rkang pa bzhi pa'i thog mar yod pa ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ mu tig mdangs su co 'dri ba'i// sen mos sgeg pa'i bgrod byed zung bkod pa'i// nor bu'i rkang stegs mthon po mkhar snyegs pa// mang mang mi bdag btud pa de drung du// thugs brtse ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ rjes su dran pa'i dri bzhon gyis// yid kyi rdzing bu rab bskul dga' ba'i rlabs// mngon par g.yos pa'i lam du zhu ris kyi// lbu dkar phreng ba 'grems la spro ba skyes// dge bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ tshogs snye ma legs smin khur po ches// kun nas rab dud sdom brtson dpag bsam ljon// bstan srid nor 'dzin rgyan du ches mtho zhing*// phrin las yal ga ris med brkyangs pa nas// bka' rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa/ mchid zhib mor 'dren pa'i snyan dngags glu// bkra shis mtshan bkra dar dang dzam+bu kaḥ// sder chags rgyal po gzig gi pags pa rnams// phyag rgya'i 'khor los mtshan pa spyi bor phebs// sems ldan rab brtag gang tshe sku drin gzhal du med pa'i lcid// thegs par dka' bar gyur na mi rung zhes// 'od srungs byin 'di sra brtan rang bzhin du// srid pa byed po des ni sprul lam snyam// cha shas can gyi gzugs can/ deng dus bsod nams gnam gyis bskos pa'i lha// dbang phyogs sa 'dzin gnyis pa'i mjal phrad la// las bzang sku yi kun phan dkyil 'khor nyid// nye bar bteg las gegs bral son pa dang*// phyogs bral dngos thob kyi dga' ba/ mi bdag yongs kyi bla nas blar// je mthor bka' lung btsan pos dbang bskur ba'i// ngo mtshar gsar pas rab myos dga' ba'i 'dzum// ci yang grol 'di khyon min su yi drin// thugs yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ rje'i gdugs dkar rtsibs ma brgya ba'i grib// ngal gsor spyod pa'i le lo'i yi dam pa'ang*// 'byung tshogs lus la nye zhos ma gtses par// gnas skabs snga mkhor bde ba'i ngang tshul lags// 'jig rten kun du dga' ster mi yi bdag

/dbang rgyas phrin las grub pa'i 'khor lo yis// rgya mtsho'i gos can dbang sgyur bskal pa'i bar// brtan pa'i shis brjod rgyal kun mgrin sgrigs shig /rnam 'dren bstan mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe/ pa'i rtsa lag bsngags 'os gang*// mi shigs ring 'tsho zho 'thung rus las skyes// rdo rje'i nus par 'jug pa'i cho ga ni// lus med thul mchog kun gyis sgrubs shig kye// zhu yig sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ngos gzhi ru// 'dren byed 'chi med bung bas 'bab pa'i stegs// lha dar wa skyes pags pa mgyogs 'gror bcas// tshul rin zhes bya'i zham ring pa des phul// zhes sa stengs stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sde dge bla chen nyid/ dba' thang du chibs sgyur gnang nas yar phebs pa'i skabs su legs so 'bul ba'i zhu yig sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bzhad pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba rgyu'i rgyan las rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu/ kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan 'dzad med phung po kun// gang 'dul sprul nas phrin las dag /lhun grub dpal ldan bla mas skyongs// mkhyen ma bsdus gzugs can/ pa'i me tog lang tsho dar bab rjes brtse yal 'dab phyogs su g.yo// byin rlabs nus pas srid zhi'i mthun min phyogs kyi rgud pa ring du bcil// phan bde'i 'dod dgu mi zad char gyis bsams kun rdzogs byed skyabs gsum gyi// rin chen ljon pas 'di na dge legs shis pa'i grib bsil 'bab stegs mdzod// deng gi dus gcig la gcig ltos rab spel/ nyid grangs med 'gro ba'i bsod nams g.yab mos lan stong du// bos pa'i shugs las rdzogs ldan bskal par 'byon 'gyur 'khor los sgyur ba khyod// dus kyi rtsis la rnam par rmongs byas rtsod ldan 'gro ba'i mgron skal du// nye bar thob pa'i dga' ba 'di slar khyod min gzhan las ci ste thob// ring nas

bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ legs byas rgya mtshor bskyil ba smon lam ri bos bsrubs pa las// legs par thon pa rmad byung byams ldan sa la spyod mchog gnyis skyes dbang*// dpag yas bstan srid bde 'byung thor tshugs mdzes byed dam par rnam bkod tshe// sngon med bde skyid snang ba dkar pos sa stengs yangs ldan pha mtha' nyul// snyam sgra can gyi rab brtag rtsal gsum rab rdzogs gsung gi 'gyur ba res// bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung mang 'dren pa yi// ngo mtshar phyogs kyi bu mos mnyan phyir du// rang gi sgra 'dzin yangs por sprul lam snyam// skyes sems ldan rab brtag sbyangs dag pa'i mkhyen rab yangs pa'i ngos// chos dang srid pa'i shes bya kun shar ba'i// khyad par dpyod la h+nu man+tha yang*// rmongs te gtam rgyud tsam gyi brdzu la zhugs/ byed srid pa can/ pos ma brdal rab yangs thugs kyi klong*// brtan par ma btsugs snying stobs brling pa yis// bcol ba med par bod khams sems can gyi// bde skyid gsar du spel ba'i tshul la rangs// chos sems zho 'thung rus pa las grub pa'i// bstan don bgyi ba rmad byung rdo rje yis// 'gal rkyen ri bo lhod pos bgrod pa can// sgra med 'gro rgyun bcad khyod legs bris mgon// khyod don gzhan 'gog pa/ zhabs phyogs bral sa 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug /gus par len yang khengs pa btang ba mtshar// snying rjes shin tu mnyen byas dam pa rnams// dman la phan 'dogs bran du gzhol min nam// lho srid min dpe/ phyogs rlung gis nyer bskyed tsha gdung dang*// dpag bsam rkang 'thung las ni dbul phongs bzhin// khyod kyi dpung pas bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs su// nad yams 'khrug rtsod mi 'byung las dbang shugs// spyi'i bsdus brjod/ gdung ba kun skyob 'dod pa thams cad kyis// re ba'i shing rta yongs su 'gengs bzod pa'i// bsam kun rdzogs byed dpag bsam khyod thob nas// rkang 'thung phal pa gzhan la ci ste smon//

bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ zla med las dbang rin chen 'khor lo yis// chab srid tha gru yangs ldan ri gling bcas// dbang gis mnga' sgyur chos rgyal nga las nu// gnyis par gyur tshul khyad par brjod mi lang*// bdag kun du phan pa/ cag dam pa'i chos phyir bshul ring nas// sa 'dir phyin pa 'dris chung 'khos dman tshe// gang bsams 'grub par nges pa'i lha khyod ni// 'gro 'di'i skal bas 'chun pa nga re 'tsheng*// 'dzam bu gser gyi pa tra glog 'gyu ma'i// mngal du sbrum byas nor bu'i zhabs gdub kyis// yongs su 'khyud pa'i lha gcig khyod zhabs dag /'gyur med rin chen khri la brtan gyur cig /tshe dpag med mgon rnam par rgyal ba mo// yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs lhag pa'i lha// thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i kat+pu ras// dus min 'chi ba'i rims nad zhi bar mdzod// rab bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa'i shis pa/ rgyas ting 'dzin spro bsdu'i pho nya yis// 'khor 'das snod bcud 'byung bzhir bcas pa las// 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len kun bsdus nas// sa la spyod mchog ring 'tsho'i dpal du stsol// rigs rigs pa'i rgyu'i shis brjod/ byed dpal mos mig gi zur mda' yis// srid na cher rlom snying la reg pa'i mod// khengs pa ma lus nyams nas khyed zhabs dag /rtse gcig 'dun pa dbang gi dngos grub stsol// mthu drag shul nyams kyi shis brjod/ stobs dpung tshogs che mchog srung ma rnams// gdong mig dmar por bskyur la khro gnyer sdus// zhal gdangs 'jigs su rung ba'i nga ro yis// bar chad gdon bgegs ring du skrod cig kye// dkon mchog rnam gsum bden pa'i stobs ni don gyis stong min bden pa dang*// rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zab mos mi bslu nges pa yi// yi ge dam pa phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gsal byas gang de yis// 'dod don shis pa'i me tog 'thor gang don gyi snying pos lci bar shog

/ces shis par brjod pas sngun bsu nas gus par zhu gsol/ da lan nged cag rnams sngon byas dge ba'i 'phen pa cung zad kyis 'phangs pa'i dal ba'i rten ming gdags su rung ba tsam zhig thob pa 'di snying po yod pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ rgyal gsung kun gyi snying po sdom pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi nod pa'i ched dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dngos su mjal ba dang skal ba mnyam pa/ 'dzam gling bsod nams kyi zhing mchog bla na med pa'i rten jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i bod dbus gtsang phyogs kyi rten gsum grags che ba phal cher gyi zhal mjal dang mchod 'bul gyi ched du/ bshul thag ring mo nas 'ong bar gegs med du son cing*/ 'di na byams dang brtse ba'i mgo 'dren gyi mchod sbyin brgya pa nyid 'gro ba'i legs byas rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang pa yangs por mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te brtan par bzhugs pa gang gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba rgyas pa stong gi mtshar sdug ma lus pa byed pos gcig tu bsdus pa snyam byed pa gang zhig bdag cag rnams kyi dbang po'i mchog gi yul du mngon sum bya ba'i phyir dang*/ chos dang srid kyi bka' stsal yang dag par zad mi shes pa'i dga' ston ngoms pa med pa rna ba'i bcud du len par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byams dang brtse bas yongs su bsgos pa'i mkhyen rab yangs pa'i dbyings nas 'phral dang yun du gzigs pa mi g.yel ba zhu ba'i mtshon byed du/ thog mar bkra shis pa'i dar kha sogs/ zhes sde srid mi'i dbang po pho la thā ji'i sku zhabs su 'bul ba'i 'go brjod dang mo'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer gyis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su byas pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ su zhig mtshan snyan ga ma ka'i// gdangs su bsgyur tsam mngon 'dod dpal// lhun grub byed po dkon mchog gsum// sa dbang shis pa'i me tog stsol// gang la skyabs song mi bslu bar// 'jigs skyob yid bzhin 'khor lo mas// mi bdag bskal par 'tsho gzhes kyi// thugs rje'i zla ba'i chu rgyun stsol// chos mthun phrin las 'khor lo yis// phyogs kyi tha gru gzhal pa la// 'phreng gegs mthun pa min pa'i phyogs// rig pa'i khro tshogs rnams kyis srungs// sngon bsags chu yi phung po las// legs byung gzugs sku'i nor bu dag

/skye 'gro'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni// mdzes sdug dpal du khyod rmad byung*// bstan srid rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor che// rdzogs par chud dka'i dogs pa yis// 'od srungs byin gyi khongs 'di yang*// byed pos yangs par ma sprul lam// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rnam dkar dge spyod ngo mtshar la// blta phyir sngo bsangs mkha'i bu mo// snang byed zung bteg blta min nam// phyogs bral sa 'dzin khengs pa yi// thor tshugs rtse mos btud pa'i yul// lcam dral zhabs zung chu skyes dag /rnam par bkod pa'i rkang stegs ni// lag 'gro'i bang mdzod las thon pa'i// nor bu'i phra tshom gyis spra ba'i// kañca na las mes po yi// 'phrul gyis bskrun lta ga la bar// dal 'byor rten gyi rkang 'thung phal// snyom las lo 'dab khur lci yang*// lhag bsam me tog khong dgod pa// zham ring rgan bus mching 'di 'bul// de'ang sa'i steng na mtshungs pa med pa sa skyong bla ma chen po zhing khams par bcas pa'i bka' lung gi bkod pas/ chu bo gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi ljongs 'dir gtsug lag khang bskrun pa'i dgongs pa shar bar brten/ dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas rgyu sbyor bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i do dam mdzad/ kho bo cag gis kyang thog ma'i gshegs gsol sa chog gi sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi bris 'bur rten bzheng kun gyi kha ta dang*/ bzo'i bya ba mthar phyin nas rab tu gnas pa'i bar gyi bgyi ba thams cad legs par grub/ da lam bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po lcam dral gyi zhabs kyi chu skyes gzhon nus ljongs 'dir legs par bcags te/ rten gsum gyi phreng ba mtha' dag la spyan ras kyi gzigs par phab pas/ bdag cag gi bgyis pa don yod du grub snyam pa'i dga' spro'i mtshon byed dang*/ 'di phyogs kyi dgon sde phan tshun 'di dag kyang sngon dus dar rgyas che rab byung tshod 'dug kyang*/

deng sang skabs ni nyams tshabs je che zhig las mi 'byung 'dug pas/ bla chen dam pa nyid ni bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpung gnyen chen po yin bzhin du rnam kun gang ci'i brtse gzigs kyi rwa ba las kyang mi bor bar bcas zhu mtshon mi stong tsam du/ lha dar dkar po srid du ring ba/ sman tsi yug ling yug gos chen yug ras yug lwa ta yug wa lpags/ spyang lpags/ gzig lpags/ gser zho/ dngul srang bdun/ chib pa/ dre'u bcas bcu gsum tshan dang*/ gsol ston stob pa'i chab mtshon lha dar/ ling lug ras yug lwa ta yug wa shun/ sbre shun/ spyang ki'i shun/ rta pho/ mdzo dang dgu tshan bcas 'di dag zhus dag bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis gus par phul ba lags/ zhes sde dge lcam dral chu klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram ngogs chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du phebs dus rang gi mdun 'jog chung ngu bgyis pa'i 'bul tho tshul rin can rang gis bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las snyigs ma 'dir// rgyal sras spyod pa skyong ba'i rnam rol gyis// rgyal bstan dri med kun du rgyas mdzad pa// rgyal ba kun dngos bla mas khyed la srungs// thugs rje'i zla ba rgyas pa'i 'dzum zer gyis// grangs med nyi bu'i dpung tshogs mthar bskrad de// rga shi med pa'i dngos grub dga' ston mkhan// bcom ldan tshe mtha' yas sogs tshe sbyin lhas// 'di na kun mkhyen bstan dang sems can gyi// phan bde'i rtsa lag rmad byung mi yi rje// sku tshe bskal pa'i srid du ring 'tsho ba'i// 'chi med dngos grub gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar stsol// gang gi rkang stegs nor bu'i ba gam can// lha mir bcas pa'i lus can mtha' dag gi /yan lag mchog gis btud pa ga la bar// zhabs zung brtan pa'i shis brjod glu ru longs// mngon 'dod mig gi zur mda' 'phangs tsam gyis// srid zhi'i stobs 'byor dang ldan che dgu dag

/rtse gcig 'dun pa'i yid 'phrog phrin las de// rigs byed 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi bdag pos sgrubs// sde bzhi phun tshogs nor bu'i phra tshom can// dge bcur spyod pa'i 'khor lo sngon 'gro ba'i// bstan jus mu med phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor kun// khyab pa'i phrin las rtag tu rgyas par mdzod// bka' khrims yangs par brdal ba'i rwa ba na// tshe dbang 'byor pa'i chu gter 'khyil ba'i klong*// ris bral sems can mkha' lding dkar po'i phreng*// skyid pas myos pa'i snyan glu len par mdzod// zla bral dpung pas bsrung bar 'os pa'i sa// dum bus ngoms pa med pa'i tshul rig nas// bod khams nor 'dzin yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di// rig byed 'byin pos ched du sprul lam snyam// de na shis pa kun gyis phyogs kun las// rnam par rgyal bar mnga' gsol mi yi dbang*// lcam dral zhabs zung ban+du dzī ba kas// nyer spud rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri drung du// lo dang zla ba'i mdza' bos mgo skyes la// ga pur tshon gyis nyer byugs gnyer ma'i sul// gdong gi dkyil 'khor la bsdus 'bangs kyi 'bangs// spro dga' cher brtas mchid du 'di skad gleng*// zhes pa'i shis brjod dang dngos po nges bstan nyung ngus sngun bsu nas gsol ba/ deng dus chu klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram ngogs/ 'od gsal lha rigs rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan khu dbon gyis mtshon mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can gyi bla ma mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byin rlabs bdud rtsis sbreng ba'i gnas/ sde dge sa skyong chen po yab mes gong ma na rim gyi thugs brtses khyab pa'i yul gru dam pa sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho pa'i lung gis/ ljongs 'dir gtsug lag khang pho brang bcas bskrun par bka' mchid dam pa gnang ster dang bcas pa legs par stsal te las kyi 'go brtan pa tshugs/

de mtshams nas byams brtse'i bdag nyid bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po lcam dral nas rgyu rdzas kyi dngos po gya nom pa stsal te dbugs dbyung bar brten/ bdag cag khu tshas sbyor bkod phun sum tshogs pas do dam khur len bgyis te/ ji ltar thugs bzhed ltar gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rten bzheng gi bgyi ba mthar phyin/ deng dus bstan 'gro spyi'i dpung gnyen chen por bzhugs pa'i lcam dral gyi nor bu rin po che dag sgos su bdag cag ltos bcas la thugs brtsis gzigs pa'i mgron skal du nye bar nod cing*/ ngal ba brgya phrag mang pos bskrun pa'i rten bzheng gi dngos po rnams spyan ras kyis gzigs pas phab pas tshe gcig ril por bsams pa'i dngos po yud tsam cig gis grub pa lta bur gyur pa'i dga' spro yongs su rdzogs pa gzugs su bgyir btub na/ 'dzam gling nor bu'i tshogs kyis phyur bur bkang ste thob pas kyang brgya stong gi char yang phod snyam ci zhig de lta na'ang rang gi bgo skal dang 'tsham par 'byor pa'i rdzing bu las thon pa'i dngos phran nyung zad tsam gyis spro dga' mchog tu brtas pa'i legs 'bul mtshon byed du bkra shis pa'i lha dar sogs brgya 'bul gyi rnam grangs 'di dag dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu tshas gus par phul ba dge bar gyur cig ces sde dge sa skyong lcam dral sku 'khor du bcas pa ldan yul chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du spyan drangs pa'i dga' ston legs 'bul gyi gleng ba rkang drug myos pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i dpal gdong gi lo smin drug zla ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin bris pa ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dpag tu med pa'i yon tan yangs pa'i mtha'// tshad la blang phyir nam mkha'i lus phra mas// sprul pa'i 'dom gyis bcal bar ma bzod par// sprin gos stug po yibs snyam dkon mchog gsum// 'di na smon lam sgeg mo'i rgyang glu yis// legs byas lang tsho dar bab mdza' na bor// bstan srid rgyas pa'i ro bda' stob slad du// skal bzang mgron du gnyer byas mi yi bdag

/ma hā bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi skye 'gro yi// mi dman bsod nams gser khri ga la bar// nyi bu'i dpung las rgyal bar dbang bskur la// gzhar yang brling ba'i cho ga sgrubs shig gu// lung rtogs chos kyi 'od zer brgya pa dang*// srid jus gtsug lag bsil ba'i zer ldan dag /nyin mtshan dar la bab pa'i ya mtshan rnga// phyogs kyi bu mos brdung snyam cis mi byed// snying sdug dbang gi tshon dmar mkhur tshos su// 'phos pa'i phrin las sgeg mo'i sgyu rtsal gyis// phun tshogs sde bzhis mngon par rgyags pa'i blo// brtan pa gzhu ltar gugs pa'i dngos grub byin// dge legs phrin las sgo brgya dbye ba la// sdang sems tsher ma'i dbal rnon gang gzings pa// ye shes snang ba bi shwa na ra'i bus// kham zas gcig tu byed la ci ste ngal// 'phags dang so so skye bo mgrin gcig tu// shis brjod snyan dngags dam pa'i glur len la// dkar po'i phyogs su dgyes pa'i lha srung rnams// rab dga'i me tog char du snyil cig kye// bgrod byed chu skyes gzhon nu'i 'bab kyi stegs// rdo rje'i re khā bkod pa ga la ba// khengs ldan phyogs kyi sa 'dzin bye ba yi// thor tshugs rtse mos nye bar btud pa der// dbyar skyes sdong bu rab ldem phang pa nas// 'dab stong lang tsho ci yang ngom pa bzhin// zham ring gyi na ba de'i smra ba'i sgo'i// 'dab ma 'dzum pa'i khrod nas 'di skad gleng*// deng dus mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid sa skyong bla ma rin po che nyid/ sa gzhi thams cad chos bzhin bskyang la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba dpal sde dge rgyal po zhes yongs su grags pa'i yab mes kyi bstan srid chu gter chen po skyong ba'i rgyal thabs su dbang bskur ba la/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal slad/ dga' ston legs dgu'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i mtshon byed du/ lha dar dkar po srid du ring ba sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dgu tshan zhig rab byung 'dod pa'i shing khyi'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nag zla'i tshes nyer gnyis la ban+de tshul khrims rin chen can gyis phul ba lags/

zhes sde dge bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho rgyal thabs su dbang bskur ba'i khri 'bul dus kyi shis brjod mtsho ldan dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i zhing gi de bzhin gshegs// ma lus 'dus pa'i rang bzhin bskal pa 'dir// thun mtshams lang tshos sgeg pa'i bla gos can// sems can smin mdzad bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// dus 'dir dpal ldan nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang*// 'jig rten bsod nams spungs pa'i rin chen khrir// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar bkra shis pa'i// legs bris me tog sil ma char du stsol// gser mngal sprul pa'i 'dom gyis bskal pa'i phreng*// gzhal yang phyogs re'i pha rol phyin min pa'i// mkhyen rab rjes su brtse dang nus pa'i bdag /mi bslu skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i snye ma g.yur du za// dge bcus brlings pa'i bstan srid dpag bsam gyi// rkang 'thung mdzes pa'i dpal khyod ring 'tsho ba'i// swasti'i sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i dbyangs su sgrogs// rnam 'dren sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i mgon// mtshan dang dpe byad snang ba 'bum bdo ba// pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por rta bdun pa'i// 'od zer gyis 'khyud ji bzhin lham mer gsal// thugs rje'i zla ba rgyas pa'i zil mngar rgyun// gang blo'i chu mtshor lhung ba'i 'phral nyid la// sa yi 'byer 'jig chen po'i sku srog ni// nyi bu'i dpung tshogs mi phyed rdo rjer sgrubs// dmar zlum gdong mig bgrad pa'i g.yar lam du// yid srub dpung pa zho 'thung rus pa las// grub kyang skad cig gnyis par tshugs min pa'i// gur mgon gdong bzhi ldan mtshon srung ma'i sdes// rgyal thabs shes pa can gyis mnga' gsol la// rnam sdang mi dang mi min 'byung po rnams// tshar gcod las kyi cho ga mngon brtsams te// kun las rnam rgyal srung ba'i mkhar du chongs// phrin las dbang gi lcags kyu gdengs tsam gyis// lam gsum khongs kyi stobs 'byor che ba dgu// dga' ba'i yul la rgyug pa'i blo bzhin du// 'gugs pa rigs byed 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi rjes// yid 'phrog phrin las kā shi mdzes dga' mas// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor khengs ldan 'gro ba rnams// phun tshogs bgo skal dar drag skyes dang bcas// thor tshugs khyod zhabs spa ba'i rgyan du byin// bstan srid rnam par rgyas pa'i gser bzang khrir// rgyal 'gyur shis pa brjod pa'i dbyar skyes rnga// 'bum phrag ldir bas mnga' gsol bla ma che// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar gyur cig gu// ring bsags bsod nams yangs par brdal ba'i mtha'// ngo mtshar mig gi dga' ston blang ched du// skabs gsum dbang pos 'dren byed stong sprul nas// bltas pas ma mthong gnyid bral brdzu la brten// skal bzang 'khor los sgyur ba'i las shugs kyi// pho nyas thob pa'i rgyal srid bdun dag dang*// stobs bcu mnga' bas shis pa'i rdzas mchog tu// byin rlabs rtags kyi 'byor pas dkrigs pa'i dbus// legs bris gdengs ka can dang mi yul gyi// rin thang shin tu che ba nor bu'i khams// bi shwa karmas bskrun snyam zhabs kyi stegs// rgyal phran grangs med btud pa ga la bar// mi bdag bka' lung rin chen ri bo'i ljid// lhag bsam mi dman phrag par rnam bkod pa'i// zham ring rgan po'i rus pa'i ke sa raḥ// 'dzum zer dkar po dgod pas 'di skad gsol// deng dus sngon bsags legs byas kyi chu gter 'khyil ba'i snying po/

ngur smrig bla gos bklubs pa chen po'i rnam pas rtsen pa'i sa skyong yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che nyid/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin lus phra'i dkyil 'khor thams cad chos mthun stobs kyi 'khor los dgyes dgur rol la bsdo ba med pa'i dbang phyug dpal sde dge chen po zhes yongs su grags pa'i ba dan rnam par bsgrengs pa'i rgyal thabs chen por/ bstan srid zung gi dpal 'byor stug po'i lhab lhub brgya phrag brtsegs pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor mnga' gsol/ las shugs phrin las kyi snang ba dkar pos phyogs kyi tha gru mtha' dag rang dbang bgyid cing*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'od brgya dgung dbus su bdo ba dang*/ sems can bde skyid sgo 'phar bye ba phrag mang cig car du 'gyed pas/ rgyal khams thams cad rdzogs ldan dus kyi skal ba sbom por sbyor ched/ chab 'bangs kyis mtshon skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal 'tsham pa'i legs 'bul dngos rdzas me tog sil mas kun nas 'thor ba'i skabs 'dir zham ring gi tha chung dge tshul rgan bu'ang*/ sngon med dga' spro gsar pa'i lang tsho ngom bzhin pas/ shis brjod snyan dngags kyi phreng bas sngun bsu ba'i legs 'bul dga' ston mtshon byed/ bkra shis pa'i lha dar/ dngul srang gsum/ ling yug ras yug gnyis/ gos chen yug sbre lpags/ wa lpags/ sram lpags/ g.yi lpags/ spyang ki'i lpags/ gzig lpags/ rta bo bcas rnam grangs bcu gsum tshan 'di bka' 'bangs rgan bu bsod nams rgyal mtshan can gyis phul ba lags so// zhes zla bral stobs kyi 'khor lo sngon 'gro sa skyong bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho pa dpal sde dge chen po zhes yongs su grags pa'i yab mes kyi gser khri la dbang phyogs gong ma chen po'i las rtags kyis mnga' gsol ba'i tshe legs 'bul gyi gleng ba bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bgyi ba 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor/

daṇ+ḍi gzhung lugs smra ba ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i dngos po'i lor dbo zla'i tshes dge bar ldan shod du bris pas rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dran pa tsam gyis 'khor 'das shis pa'i dpal// ci 'dod 'jo ba'i yon tan zab rgya che// skyabs song bslu ba mi mnga' dkon mchog gsum// dpal ldan mi bdag dge ba'i me tog stsol// bsod nams mi dman gser gyi sgo nga las// legs par 'khrungs pa'i sa 'dzin 'jig rten mes// bstan srid sgeg mor blta ba'i gdong mdzes can// gtsug lag rig byed 'doms pa'i dbang phyug gi /zhabs stegs legs bris gdengs can mi yul gyi// rin chen rin thang che ba brgya phrag las// sna tshogs lag pa'i 'phrul gyis bskrun pa la// phyogs bral rgyal phran btud pa ga la bar// chos mthun mdzad pa'i chu 'dzin stug po la// rnam bkra yid kyi spu sdug mdongs mtha' can// spro dga'i sgro gshog zlum por bsgyur dang mnyam// zhu ris mgrin pa'i dbyangs chung 'di skad gsol// sngon bsags snye ma legs smin khur bu yis// kun nas rab dud byams ldan yongs 'du'i shing*// chos srid gtsug lag nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor dpyid// phrin las yal ga ris bral phyogs su brkyangs// thugs rje'i gdung skyob dkar po 'khor ba'i grib// gangs ldan ljongs kyi skye 'gro ngal 'tsho zhing*// dge bcur spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan gzhon nu la// legs sbyar 'phrin yig phyogs kyi rna bar 'jebs// chab 'bangs byams pas bskyangs pa'i sku drin ljid// thags pa dka' bar gyur na mi rung zhes// 'od srungs byin gyi dkyil 'khor sra brtan du// srid pa'i byed pos nges par sprul lam snyam// gson gshin grangs med phyogs nas byin pa yi// dkor rdzas dkon mchog phyogs su gtong sems kyi// smon lam tsam las bya thabs bral ba bdag

/gegs med phyin 'di'ang khyod drin kho nar khums// grangs med sa 'dzin bye ba'i bla nas blar// bsod nams gnam gyis bskos pa lha khyod kyi// byams brtses bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs mi srun gyi// tsher mas dben pa'i sku drin gtang rag tu// skye bar 'dris pa'i las kyi mdza' na bos// dbang thang bgo skal byin pa'i dpal 'byor las// nyung zad phul bar snying rje'i spyan zur gyi// gzigs pas lhung ba'i bka' drin ci yang stsol// zhes lha ldan gyi sde srid mi'i dbang phyug chen po la mjal phyag gi rten mtshon 'bul tho'i gong brjod khyab mjug dgyes pa'i zhabs bsil zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge/ //phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas chu klung bdag /dpag yas smon lam ri bos bsrubs pa'i bcud// stobs kyi 'khor los 'dzam gling mkhar sgyur ba'i// sa skyong mi yi zla ba rgyal gyur cig /skye dgu'i bsod nams rab yangs khang bzang rtser// mdzes byed sku yi yid bzhin rgyal mtshan gang*// bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gzhil ba'i rtsa lag tu// 'pho bral bskal pa ji srid zhabs brtan shog /rab 'byams rig pa'i gzhung lugs srid do cog /nyams 'gyur bye bas sgeg pa'i rgyud mangs glur// len la bsnyengs pa mi mnga'i snyan dgu'i gdangs// 'gag med rdo rje'i khams su zhabs brtan shog /mkhyen dpyod nor bu'i rtsig ngos rab dwangs par// gtsug lag 'bod grogs gzugs brgya rnam bkra ba'i// ngo mtshar blo ldan ha nu man+tha las// kun rtog phal gyis dpyod nus min de rgyal// dpag med byams dang rjes brtse'i 'dren byed dag /dkyus ring spros pa'i rwa bar phyogs bral gyi// skye bo'i ngal gso bla na med gyur pa'i// phan bde'i dpal gyi byed por rtag brtan shog /las shugs gser gyi tsakra ring song ba'i// khongs su 'khod pa'i gangs can skye bo'i tshogs// rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i dga' ston gzhon nu la// 'bod pa'i lha khyod bskal pa'i ring 'tsho bar// srung ba'i gur khyim dkon mchog gsum gyis phubs// sku tshe'i ka ba tshe sbyin lha yis tshugs// bzhed don srung ma'i tshogs kyis legs bsgrubs nas// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i bkra shis stsol// zhes pa sde srid mi'i dbang po dā chings bā thur ba zhabs brtan smon lam gyi tshigs bcad ut+pal do shal zhes pa 'di ni don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// dpag yas skye ba'i legs byas rgya mtsho'i klong*// yon tan rin chen rdul brtsegs phrag pa nas// chos srid phrin las nyi zla'i 'od snang can// sa skyong mchog gi lhun po rgyal gyur cig /phyogs bral sa 'dzin bye ba'i thor tshugs rtses// lan brgyar btud cing bsngags pa'i man+dā ras// kun nas gtor ba gang gi zhabs stegs ni// srid na mngon mthor 'phags pa de drung du// rtse gcig gus pa'i bdag lus ljon pa'i phang*// snyim pa'i thal sbyar lo 'dab stong g.yo zhing*// rab dga' sar pa'i me tog 'dzum bzhin par// zhu gsol ko ki la yi dbyangs chung 'bul// bsod nams brgya byin lag pas legs bris pa'i// dge legs mtshan gyi ri dwags rtags bkra ba'i// bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i ku mud gnyen// skye dgu'i skal bzangs mkha' dbyings brtan pa nas// gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'od zer bye ba'i mdzod// phrin las nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// chab srid gling bzhi'i lha lam bgrod pa la// rab dga'i ga zha mi 'byin blo ldan su// mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa'i gom gcig gis// 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs gzhal te// mi mthun phyogs kyi stobs ldan dpung bcom la// zla bral sred med bu yi stobs su rdzogs// zhes shis brjod bsngags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngus mdun bsu ba'i zhu ba sogs bris so// zhes pa 'di'ang sde srid mi'i dbang po dā chings bā thur sku zhabs su zhu yig gi gong brjod du don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang la skyabs song bsod nams kha lo pas// byin rlabs shing rta drangs pa'i khong yangs nas// dngos grub skyes bzang gsar pa'i dga' ston mkhan// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla mas dge legs stsol// bcu drug lang tshor mtshan bzang sgeg pa'i lus// 'char ka'i nyi 'od kyis bran mtshams sprin gyi// khong nas byed po'i 'phrul gyis phyung ba ltar// rab mdzes lha mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rjer 'dud// gser bzang pa tra yid kyi gar mkhan mas// dam du bzung ba'i rin chen phra mang gi

/gdub bus spa ba'i sor rtses rgyud mangs las// snyan pa'i glu len tshangs pa'i sras mor bsngags// de ltar bsngags pa brjod pa'i gling bu la// rjes dgongs 'dod don smon lam dpang po ru// legs par bzhugs nas mthun 'gyur rol mo stong*// cig car 'khrol la ma g.yel thugs rjes skyongs// phun tshogs sde bzhi rab rgyas chos srid kyis// 'chi med lha yang skal ba dman bgyid na// rgyal phran phal gyi stobs 'byor rmig rjes chur// bgyid la dka' min sngon dge'i shugs byung 'dir// skyes sbyangs stobs kyi bloṃ groṃs bcu drug cha// rdzogs pas gsung rab rgyaṃ mtshoṃ rgyas byed pa'i// lha sras zla ba 'gro ba'i thor tshugs rtser// ring 'tsho'i me tog rgyal kun stsol gyur cig /shes rab rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i sha ba ris// gzhung mang 'chad rtsom goms pa'i 'ching zhags su// grangs med blo ldan yid kyi ri dwags rnams// dbang med bcings te rang dbang spyod par shog /las dbang gser gyi 'khor los gangs can ljongs// tha gru rab yangs chab srid ri gling bcas// dbang gis mnga' sgyur chos srid lha mi'i dpal// 'dzad med gter la rtag par spyod gyur cig /gang tshe srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs dpal// dbrog 'dod phyi dang nang gi 'gal rkyen dgra// bdo bar gyur na bstan srung rab 'byams kyis// lhag ma med bcom dga' ba'i ru mtshon sgrengs// de skad smra ba rang blo'i rdzing bu nas// mthu nus nor bu 'byung re ma mchis kyang*// lhag bsam smon lam rten 'brel pad+ma'i 'dab// 'dzum 'dis khyed la don med ma gyur cig /'grig 'grig ngag gi shis brjod nyung ngu 'di// lhang lhang grags pa gsal ldan lha sras kyi// snyan snyan bka' stsal sgra 'dzin lhung ba'i mod// wal wal gang dran tshul rin zhes byas bris// zhes sde dge lha sras blo gros rgya mtsho'i bka' lung gis shog bu 'dir rtsom chos gang rigs shig gyis la bskul zhes phebs par ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis shis brjod du bris nas phul ba'o//

// ༄// mkhyen dpyod mig gis gtsug lag kun// legs mthong sa skyong yum sras drung*// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rnam rgyas pa'i// rgyal khab dag pa gang las so// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i zegs ma re// gang zhig snying la sim pas mthong ba'i chos// gang dag slad mar bcas par dge ba'i mgron// gang yang 'gugs pa dkon mchog gsum gyis srungs// skye nas skye bar las bzang pho nya yis// bsod nams mi dman lha yi khang pa ru// gcig tu bsdus nas gtsug lag rgya mtsho la// longs su spyod mdzad yum sras kun gyi dung*// dal brgyad 'byor bcu rdzogs pa'i chu gter du// ngal gsor spyod pa'i nang shes mkha' lding dkar// dga' bas rgyas pa'i mgrin pa rab bteg nas// snyan ngag mchid kyi rdza rnga 'di skad brdung*// ring nas bskyed pa'i dge legs snye ma yis// mngon par rab lci sku yi dpag bsam phreng*// chos srid rnam par rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du// dge spyod lo 'dab g.yo ba rna ba'i dpyid// de tshe gtong ba chen po'i mdzod kyi sgo// rnam par phye ba las byung bza' dang bca'// ma tshang med pa'i dga' ston gya nom dang*// shis brjod legs bris bu mo'i glur bcas son// e ma sum rtsen gnas su phyin pa med// mig skya'i mdzod du 'jug thabs ma brtsams shing*// dzam+bu rkang 'thung las kyang phrogs min par// mi zad dga' ston che 'di thob pa mtshar// sngon bsags legs byas rtsal gyis 'phangs pa'i rten// thob pa don yod snying pos lci slad du// dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa de 'dzin bcas// sri zhur bgyid pa'i bya ba mi g.yel tsam// skabs mchid gleng ba gsar tshes gnam lo 'di'i// thog mtha' kun du dge ba'i shis brjod kyis// nye bar mtshon pa'i lus dang tshe dpal dag /gong du bskyed mtshon dga' ston stob pa ni// yid 'ong dbyar skyes phreng ba rgyas pa las// nye bar btus pa'i 'bras bu 'bru bcud rigs// ji snyed dag dang bzhes gro thud la sogs// ro bcud phun sum tshogs ldan skyes 'di phul// slad kyi char yang mi shigs sku'i ri dbang*// bde dang 'byor pa'i mtsho gling rtag 'tsho zhing*// dam pa'i chos mthun phrin las nyi zla yi// snang ba ring du 'phro ba'i smon lam gsol// rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog dang yi dam lha'i// gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod snyan pa'i gdangs// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su 'gro ba gang*// bskal pa'i srid du 'gag par ma gyur cig

/thos dang bsam bsgom stobs kyis sbyangs pa'i blos// shes bya kun gyi de nyid legs mthong nas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsa ba ma rig pa'i// mun pa shes rab ral gris chod gyur cig /sangs rgyas bkra shis don gnyis lhun gyis grub// chos kyi bkra shis thar pa'i phyogs rnams gsal// dge 'dun bkra shis lha mi'i mchod pa'i 'os// bslu med bkra shis gsum gyis slar yang srungs// spro dga' sman gyi nags klung nas// dal gyis 'bab pa'i ngag tshig rgyun// dkar mdzes rten gyi lbu phreng dag /lang tsho ngom pa bzhin du thal// zhes pa 'di yang sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde'i sku zhabs su 'dzom thog pa yum sras nas lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'byor pa dang*/ dga' ston gyi lan 'bul ba'i tshe drung yig kun dga' bstan pa'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// sngon gyi smon lam bden pa'i pho nya yis// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs dga' ston du// dge ba'i lam nas bos pa lha yi sras// chos mig yangs pa'i lcam dral zhabs stegs drung*// las bzangs spun zlas sbrel ba'i brtse gdung las// mngon par skyes pa'i zhu ris 'bul ba ni// kun phan gzhon nu legs mthong tshangs pa'i bu// rab dga'i 'dzum dkar grol ba bzhin du mdzes// sngon byas dge ba'i sa bon rma med kyis// nyer bskyed je mtho'i rigs kyi dpag bsam shing*// bsod nams lo 'dab phyogs su rgyas pa'i khrod// chos mthun spyod pa'i me tog ci yang bkra// gang tshe mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa'i rten// bskal pa'i srid du brtan byed cho ga dag /las kyi byed pos lan brgyar bsgrubs pa la// dus 'dzin bye ba'i dpung gis gzhom du ci// 'di na yid bzangs dang bcas 'jig rten gyi// thor tshugs sba ba'i yongs 'dzin mi'i nor bu// bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyi gzi 'bar zhing*// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i khri 'phang brtan// gang de'i thugs rje nus pa'i grib bsil du// bslab zhi'i rwa bar zhugs pa'i dge sbyong yang*// gnas skabs bde ba'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba la// rnam g.yeng min pa'i zug 'byin 'di na su// dus der 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag pa'i// chab 'bangs kun du dge zhing shis pa dang*// tshogs zung dbyar gyi chu gter rjes 'gro phyir// 'dus pa'i 'phags tshogs bsnyen bkur brtun pa'i skabs// sgra dbyangs brgya ldan gnam lo'i rgyal po gang*// gsar du tshes 'dir shis pa'i rten 'brel du// ro bcud phun sum tshogs pas 'phags tshogs kyang*// dgyes par skyed 'os bza' bca'i rnam pa 'ga'// 'thor dang 'phags pa'i skyon rnams spong byed du// rnam bkra rtags kyi 'khor los spud pa 'di// yid kyi zla gzhon lta bu'i lcam dral dag

/mi shigs nyer 'tshor bgyid pa'i gsos 'di dang*// a ho mtshan gyi gling bu bsgyur tsam gyis// mi mthun rgud pa'i dgrar gyur dkon mchog gsum// deng 'dir gnas skabs mthar thug bsam pa'i don// gegs med 'grub pa'i shis pas 'di dag srungs// de skad smon pa dang bcas rnam byung gi /zla ba'i phung po rgyu skar mchus nya ba'i// dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes dge bar// lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab nyid nas phul// zhes pa 'di'ang sde dge bla brang nas 'dzom thog par sa 'brug lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'bul ba'i tshe ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang gi zhabs rdul gtsang mas bran pa'i mod// gang dag mi mthun rgud pa kun bcil te// gang bsam dge legs 'grub pa'i sgo 'phar 'bum// gang yang 'byed pa bla mas khyed la srungs// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i lcags kyu bskyong tsam gyis// srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba dkon mchog gsum// deng 'dir brtse gcugs lha sras lcam dral dag /kun las rnam rgyal shis pa'i me tog stsol// dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las rab rgyal ba'i// 'chi med rtag pa rdo rje'i tshe de ni// bde ldan mgon po rnam par rgyal ma dang*// yid bzhin 'khor lo lhag pa'i lha yis stsol// nyes pa'i phyogs las bsrung zhing legs pa brgyar// sbyor ba'i phrin las dpal ldan nag po che// lcam dral gdong bzhi dpal gyi mgon po sogs// bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srungs rnams la bcol// 'od dmar ut+pa la yi 'ching zhags de// lha mi khengs ldan 'gro snying la btab pas// rang dbang rtse gcig 'dun pa dbang gi las// rigs byed tshogs bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal pos sgrubs// bsam don sgrub pa'i kha 'dzin rgyab brten dang*// nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe rnams// dkar phyogs mngon dga'i ru mtshon cher sgreng ba'i// bod skyong yul lha zor dor rnams kyis byos// dpal ldan mi bdag lcam dral 'di dag gi

/ji ltar thugs kyi bzhed pa gang dang gang*// gegs med legs par grub ste rab dga'i glu// snyan dgu srid rtser khyab par sgrogs par shog /ring nas skal bzang gser gyi skud pa yis// 'tshems legs skyabs gcig mchod yon spun zlar bcas// rings par lhan cig 'dzom pa'i dga' spro'i 'dzum// brgya phrag grol ba'i bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /bkra shis grangs ldan shis brjod snyan dngags kyi// me tog gsar pa bstar ba'i do shal 'dis// brgyan par 'os pa'i lha sras zung dag gi /rkang stegs nor bu'i ba gam ga la bar// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon dge zhing*// kun dga'i ring lugs dar bab sa'i thig ler// rgyal thabs phrin las rjes su skyong ba pas// lhag bsam rgya mtsho las byung skyes 'di 'bul// zhes shis brjod me tog do shal zhes pa 'di ni sde dge bla chen nas gcung blo gros rgya mtsho dbus gtsang du phebs skyel mdzad pa'i shis brjod du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// gang zhig skyabs su nges par bsten tsam gyis// gnas skabs mthar thug rgud pa ring bcom nas// bsam don snying po bde blag stsol ba la// yon tan zla med dkon mchog gsum gyis srungs// dpag yas legs byas gnam gyi mthongs yangs nas// mi bdag rigs kyi skye bar zlos pa'i gar// brtse gdung rmad byung lha sras mched lcam dag /rnam kun shis pa'i dngos po grub gyur cig /lam gsum nor bu'i 'byor pa rgya chen las// sna tshogs las pas bsgrun snyam rkang stegs kyis// ban+du dzī ba ka dpal 'thab pa'i zhabs// g.yung drung rang bzhin bteg pa ga la bar// srid par skye ba'i mched kyis sbrel ba bdag /kun phan gzhon nu yongs mthong gnyis skyes bzhin// dga' ba gya nom 'thungs pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis// khor yug dri ma bkru bzhin 'di skad gleng*// bskal pa lu gu rgyud du bsod nams kyi// sa bon btab rgya mi che ba min na// brgya lam bskal par 'thob dka' thub gsung gi

/snying po sdom pa'i snod du gyur 'di ci// zab yangs chos kyi chu klung yongs sdud pa'i// skal ba bzang ldan blo yi chu gter dag /don gnyis lhun grub yon tan rin chen 'byung*// ring por mi thogs 'byung ba'i tshul la rang*// sngon byung rgyal ba'i myu gus spyad rjes su// bslab pa'i dam bca' brling la rnam pa brgyas// nye zho brtsams pa ma bzod mda' lnga pa// rang gzugs stong pa'i brdzu la zhugs sam snyam// mgrin pa gtsug lag du ma'i 'byung gnas las// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das don grub pa'i gtam// snyan dgu phyogs kyi sgeg mo'i thos pa 'dzin// rnam par spud pa'i rgyan du 'di rmad byung*// yid gcugs gzugs kyi rnam pa kun rtog gi /ri mo yid kyi ngos su 'drir zhugs tshe// zhal 'dzum zla ba'i spun zla 'dren byed yul// mngon gyur dga' ba'i ro 'di su las thob// gang tshe rnam par dpyod pa'i mdzub rtse yis// daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung gi rgyud mangs brdung ba la// rang gi nyid du rnam brtag mtsho ldan ma// yi ge'i zol gyis lhags pa yin snyam bgyid// zhes kun dga' khong nas rgyas pa'i snyan dngags kyi 'dzum zer cung zad sngon du song nas skabs kyi gleng ba 'bul ba/ deng dus grangs med skye ba'i bsod nams kyi pho nyas srid zhi'i dge legs kyi mgron du nye bar khugs pa'i lha sras lcam dral gyi gzugs sku'i nor bu bzung dag kha ba'i ljongs kyi nor ldan brtan ma'i lto ba dbus gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar/ yid srub dpung du bcas pa'i kha rlangs kyi nye zhos ma bslad cing*/ dal 'byor rten gyi snying po bla na med pa blang ba'i bzhed don gyi gtso bo/ bstan pa'i snang byed chos kyi rgyal po gang dag bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong don che ba rnams mjal zhing*/ sgo gsum longs spyod bcas pa'i sgo nas mnyes pa'i zhal las/

rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs kyi snying po sdom pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa zab cing rgya che ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'byor pas/ bdag rgyud gtams pa sogs thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag chos mthun gegs med nyid du legs par bsgrubs nas/ deng 'dir bdag cag ltos dang bcas pa'i 'dren byed dbang po'i dga' ston du legs par son cing*/ bstan srid zung gi ngo mtshar gtam snyan 'chi med lus phra'i gling bu la 'gran pa'i snyan dngags kyi phreng ba dang chab cig la rang gnang skyes kyi dngos po gya nom stsal bar bcas/ gang ci'i legs mdzad bka' drin gyi phung po srid pa'i rtse mor lud pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i legs so dang*/ dbu thon dga' ston gyi mtshon byed du lha dar sogs bris/ smras pa/ pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por nyi gzhon gyis// 'khyud ltar rab brjid tshe mtha' yas pa yis// 'di na lha sras lcam dral bskal pa brgyar// 'tsho gzhes cho ga tshangs pa'i dbyangs su sgrogs// zhes pa 'di ni sa skyong bla ma khri chen pa nyid nas gcung blo gros rgya mtsho lcam sring dbus gtsang nas phebs pa'i dbu thon legs 'bul gyi gong brjod du/ don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang zhig 'bad rtsol kun du rtog med par// 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs byed yon tan gyi// rkang pas 'thung mchog skal bzang 'phrog nus can// skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyis dge legs stsol// bsod nams mthu chen rang bzhin yid bzang ba// legs bris gzhon nu'i khrod nas 'gro ba 'di'i// skal ba bzang pos mgron du bos pa lta'i// stobs kyi dbang phyug sa gzhi skyong chen gyi// res bral smra ba mkhas pa'i mgrin bsgrigs nas// bsdebs legs snyan dngags gdangs su bsgyur nas ni// swasti sgra dbyangs bsngags pa'i gnas gyur pa'i// sna tshogs rin chen zhabs stegs ga la bar// sa skyong rigs kyi dbyar skyes nags khrod nas// dal 'byor rten ldan yal ga ma nyams pa'i// phang par ngal gso sems kyi ko ki las// spro dga'i 'go 'dzin rab bteg 'di skad gsol// sngon bsags bsod nams dag byed phung po'i klong*// mdzes brjid ngur smrig 'chang gi mdog bzang ri// chos srid dpyod pa'i snang byed zung gsal zhing*// chab srid 'od srungs byin gyi dkyil 'khor brten// mi sbyin skyes kyis sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// grags pa'i mu khyud rtsal gyis 'chi med grong*// rjes su skyong ngo snying brtses brlan ldan pa'i// sa 'dzin khyod kyis chab 'bangs mtha' dag go

/rgyal ba'i myu gu dam pa'i snying stobs kyis// dge chos grangs med sdud pas mi ngoms pa'i// ngo mtshar chu bo'i gter gyis dag byed rgyun// ji snyed btung yang tshim mtha' med pas bstan// phrin las snang ba dkar po brdal ba'i khongs// mi dman legs byas stobs kyis drangs byas pa'i// rdzogs ldan dus kyi dga' ston gzhon nu la// ris bral 'god pa'i thugs bskyed 'di rmad byung*// gang tshe gnam lo gsar pa'i dus ston du// shis brjod snyan dngags phreng dang chab cig tu// sna tshogs bza' bca'i phung po gya nom dag /'chi med mdzod nas 'phos snyam ci yang son// 'di na bslu med las kyi byed po yi// 'byung lnga'i rdul brtsegs bdag lus khang bu yang*// nye zho'i dri bzhon stobs kyis ma gtses par// gang ci'i lhag bsam ka ba brling ba'i skabs// deng 'dir rab myos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi// dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa nyid du mi yi bdag /'khor bcas shis pa sgrub byed dang po'i 'phrin// snyan 'jebs glu len yid bzang lus phra mas// tha dad yul gru dag nas mngon bsgrubs pa'i// dkar mngar shing thog sha sogs bzhes bya'i rigs// gtsang mar legs bstar yi gar sim byed 'di// sdom brtson sa skyong lang tsho'i bcud len 'bul// gang mtshan yi ge'i sgra brnyan brdung ba'i dbyangs// rna bar sim 'phral bde ster tshe yi lhas// brtse ldan mi yi dbang phyug bskal pa brgyar// brtan byed srog gi cho ga sgrubs shig kye// rnam dkar dge bcu'i khrims kyi 'khor lo yis// bsil ldan ljongs kyi nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor ni// yangs par bdag gir bgyid la gegs bral ba'i// phrin las dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis sgrubs// chab 'bangs kyis mtshon 'jig rten skye bo rnams// bkres nad 'thab rtsod bskal pa kun bral ba'i// bde 'byor rgyas pa'i stegs la ngal gso zhing*// 'jig rten yang dag lta la gzhol gyur cig

/de skad rab myos lo yi nyi 'od kyis// dga' ba'i 'dab stong rnam par phye ba las// shis brjod rkang drug glu dbyangs len pa mos// rten phran 'dab ma mnyen par bsgyur kyin thal// ces rab myos lo gsar shar ba'i dga' ston gyi tshe shis brjod legs 'bul gyi gong brjod du don gnyer gyi ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rgyal bas legs gsungs 'chi med zil dngar gyis// bslab gsum lus rtsal rdzogs pa'i legs bris gtso// lugs brgyar dpyod pa'i spyan stong 'dzum min pa// chos ldan sa spyod dbang po'i zhabs stegs drung*// skye ba phal gyi sdong bu phra ldem rtser// dge sbyong brtul zhugs tshul 'chang ga ma las// gtsug lag rig pa'i ge sar 'dzum dbus nas// bka' len bung ba myos pa'i dbyangs chung 'bul// dpag yas bsod nams gdengs can spyi bo nas// nyer 'phos dal 'byor rdzogs pa'i bsam 'phel dbang*// bstan srid phun tshogs lhab lhub rgyal mtshan rtser// rnam par bkod tshe dge legs 'dod pa 'jo// gang tshe gnas tshul mchid pa'i gzhan gsos kyis// tshogs gsum lang tsho rgyags pa'i glu len bzhin// mig gi bgo skal rmad byung 'dul mdzod dang*// thams cad rig pa'i 'grel chen bcas stsal ba// phyag rgya'i 'khor lo kā shi mdzes dga' ma'i// yid 'phrog mkhur tshos mdangs su 'tsher ba gang*// sug par legs son kun dga' sar pa'i dpal// rab dga'i sa min gzhan gyis ci ste mtshon// 'dir 'khod tha mal rang rgyud sra mkhregs khams// sems can re ba 'gengs byed bla med kyi// byang chub chen po'i mdog bzang phung po ru// dad gsum thabs kyi 'gyur byed mi bskyud skabs// mtshams zhus snying po sa spyod dbang po nyid// lugs zung shes bya gzhal ba'i mkhyen rab srang*// 'khyog po'i rnam par mi 'dzin sngon las kyi// byed pos lan brgyar bsrangs la ci bgyir yod// 'on te chu gter chen po ji snyed kyi// chu klung yongs btung tshim pa mi srid pas// mang thos dbang po khyod kyang legs bshad cha// phra mos ngoms pa med pa'i ngang tshul mtshon// gang la blo gtad mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter gyur dkon mchog gsum// ji srid 'tsho'am tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs// yongs bzung sdom pa kun gyis khyod rgyud gtams// de slad mthong ba'i chos dang slad mar bcas// legs nyes 'bras bur gang sbyor de dag la// blo ltos ling nger legs bkal phra rags kyi// gzhi slob bslab tshul thugs la mnga' bzhin dang*// 'dir snang bde ba'i smig rgyu'i chur sred pa'i// yid kyi ri dwags mtha' med sdug bsngal thang*// 'khyams kyin 'khor ba'i so nam cher brtsams kyang*// da dung phyogs re tsam yang grub pa su// gal te grub kyang ya ma brlar mkhyen nas// srid las nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi// bslab gzhi 'chang gi skye ba mnos 'di ko

/skal ba sbom po'i grangs su lags mkhyen mdzod// gcig tu rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs chos// tshad mar 'doms pa'i rgyal po btsong kha pa'i// lugs mchog thos bsam sgom pa lhur blang du// yod par las kyi byed pos bskos par nges// de don dge sbyong byed pa'i chos tshul bzhi// ji bzhin bskrun pa'i yi ge khyod thugs kyi// me long dag pa'i ngos su gsal ba ltar// 'phral gyi ched du gtan 'dun gtong mi bya// tshe rabs du mar drin gyis legs bskyangs pa'i// ma rnams bde zhing sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi// byams brtse bcos min rgyud la skyes bar du// nyams su bstar ba theg chen lam gyi gzhi// bdag don yal bar bor yang sems can khams// rnam par mi 'tshe bde bar 'god pa'i thabs// lhur len chos rgyal rnams kyi spyod mchog ste// rgyal sras khyod kyang spyad bya'i snying por khums// sdug bsngal rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// gnyen po bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i sems// byang chen lam gyi bcud do tshul khrims gsum// brtson ldan nyid kyang bslab bya'i gnas su 'tshal// bdag lta'i mun pa mthar byed gang zag dang*// chos bdag zung gis ma reg stong pa nyid// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i tshul rtogs na// srid pa hrul por byed pa'i gdams par gsungs// de skad rnam gsal ngag gis gdams pas mtshon// phra zhib rgyas par mdo sngags chos kyi tshul// sgrib pa'i dri bral mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa// mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes gyur rab 'byams smra// rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i chos las skyes pa'i mtshan// blo bzang smon lam bod pa'i 'dzum sgros kyis// ut+pal dmar po bzhad pa'i khong gsing las// rkang drug glu dbyangs len de mnyan par 'os// bkas stsal snye ma baiḍūr g.ya' sel gyi// glegs bam lag pa'i grangs mnyam gur stag zhon// gsol mchod bskang ba'i rim pa dang bcas pa// 'dren byed yangs pa'i g.yar lam gzigs par phab// slad du rnam dkar stobs kyis bskrun pa'i sku// bskal par 'tsho gzhes cho ga rgyas kun gyi// bkra shis dbyangs su ldir dang lhan cig nyid// legs gsungs snyan 'jebs rol mo 'khrol yang 'tshal// sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal du rkang drug glu// len par mi spro med ltar zhu ris dbyangs// 'degs byed rten gyi 'dab ma g.yo ldan 'di// lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab ba gam nas// thu mi'i brda srol 'chang ba'i chos smra bas// mtshun za gos su gyon pa'i nor bdag bu'i// bgrang bya 'dzin byed grags pa'i zhag gi mdzod// chu stod dga' mas rtsen pa'i tshes la phul// zhes hor gyi yul gru skyong ba ma zur chos mdzad par phul ba'i zhu yig rkang drug mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa'o//

// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ gang gi thugs rje rab yangs spyan gyi zur// gang du lhung bar gnas skabs mthar thug gi /gang bsam yid bzhin 'jo ba dkon mchog gsum// gang dag bzhugs pas 'di na dge legs stsol// zla med las shugs btsan po'i nyag phran gyis// bar chad bden bral 'tsho ba yongs phrogs nas// bzhed don grub pa'i smin legs si tā dang*// dgyes dgur spyod pa'i mi bdag rā ma ṇaḥ// rnam 'dren bstan la ri mor bgyid pa yi// thugs bskyed snying stobs mi dman ches brling ba// gang la yod de chos ldan rgyal po zhes// bsod nams che ldan yongs kyi rtse mor bsngags// lha sras gang gi bgrod byed ngang pa mo// rkang gdub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung ba dag /rnam par rtsen pa'i rkang stegs nor bu'i rdzing*// sa 'dzin yongs kyi mgo bos btud pa der// smon lam dge ba'i mtshar sdug rgyang glu yis// phan tshun mnyes gshin ming nas 'bod bzhin du// 'dir snang brtse ba'i mched du lhags pa'i mgron// las kyi lag zung sbrel bdag 'di skad mchid// de'ang 'di ltar/ deng gi dus na sgrun du med pa'i bsod nams stobs kyi lang tsho mngon par bdo zhing*/ gtsug lag lugs brgya dpyod pa'i 'dren byed dkyus su bsrings pa'i sa bdag chen po nyid/ lha dang mi las 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar bye ba cig car du phye ba lta bu'i bgo skal la bde bar longs su spyod par gyur nas/ slar yang ji skad du/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas// dge slong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la// sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi pha rol tu// sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so// zhes gdams pa ltar zang zing gi 'byor pa snying pos dben pa las/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po blang phyir/ yul dbus gyur 'chang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su/

'di ltar chos thams cad kyi rgyal po las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i// yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ rigs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das te// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dge 'dun gyi 'dus tshogs bsam las 'das par dngos po gya nom pa'i 'bul 'gyed dang mang ja stob cing*/ rten gsum byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams la/ mchod pa'i khyad par dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba dag gis bsti stang du byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ brjed cing phyag btsal bar bgyis te/ rang re'i yab mes gong ma chos dbyings su thim pa rnams kyi dgongs pa 'gengs pa dang*/ da ltar 'tsho gzhes su mchis pa rnams kyi rgyud la'ang*/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs las/ seng ge rnam par rtse ba gang gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lo gcig gam/ lo brgya'am/ lo stong du yang rung ste/ bde ba'i yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod rten rnams la me tog 'bul lam/ chu snyim pa gang tsam 'thor ram/ byug pa'i thig le 'dri'am/ me tog gi nyal nyil 'phyag gam/ byug pa 'bul lam/ spos 'bul lam/ bdug spos 'bul lam/ mar me 'bul te phul nas dga' ba'i sems kyis gom pa'i stabs 'ga' bor te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo zhes smra ba de dag ni/ seng ge rnam par rtse ba/ bskal pa'am/ bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong du'am/ bskal pa brgya stong dag tu ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur ba de'i gnas med do zhes yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la mchod pa nyung zad re phul bas kyang ngan 'gro dang log pa'i lam du ltung bar mi 'gyur bar gsungs na/

ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po bskrun pa'i sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bskrun te mthar thug gi don phul du byung ba grub cing*/ gnas skabs sku tshe dang bstan srid rgyas pa'i rim gror bcas legs par grub nas/ slar yang grags pa'i zla snang dkar pos phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'gengs bzhin par gegs med du son pa'i dga' ston mtshon byed la bkra shis lha dar sogs bri'o// smras pa/ a ho snga na med par spro ba'i mtshor// tshig sbyor 'dab stong skyes pa'i phreng ba gang*// chos la blo gros phyogs pa'i lha 'khor bcas// rtag par 'tsho ba'i rgyan du spud par bgyi// dkon mchog phyogs su gtong phod mi dman par// legs byas ji snyed bsags pa de dag kyang*// byang chub spyod pa'i chu bdag 'phel ba'i grogs// yi rang zla gzhon thigs pas bran bgyi'o// rnam 'dren bstan la dad pa'i sa bdag gis// rnam dkar dge ba blo 'das bgyis pa gang*// rnam dag chos dbyings zab mor sim ste slar// rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyu ru bsngo// zhes pa sa skyong bsod nams mgon pos dbus gtsang phyogs kyi yon gnas dam pa rnams su dge gtong rgya chen po bsgrubs nas/ gegs med phebs pa'i tshe sde dge bla ma nyid nas dga' ston stob pa las brtsams pa'i 'bel mchid 'dab stong phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dri med lung gi brgyan pa'i gling ba 'di ltar gyis shig ces bka' lung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su byas pa'o// // ༄༅// phul byung stobs kyi gom pas bod chen gyi// sa stengs legs gzhal nyer 'tshe'i stobs ldan dpung*// rkang 'og rab bcing sa spyod sred med bu'i// bgrod byed zung bkod rin chen khri drung du// sde bzhi phun tshogs rigs kyi skyed tshal khrod// bstan 'dzin sā la'i ljon pa'i brtul zhugs la// gegs med la gnas gleng mo'i dri bsung ni// snyan dngags rdul gyi rgyal mtshan bskyon nas 'bul// gsung mchid phebs don ji bzhin nyid thugs la// dgyes bskyed rta mchog ston zla bye ba yi// mdzes sdug bi shwa karma'i mig 'phrul gyis// gcig tu spungs ltar dkar mdzes che mchog 'di// dbang sngon zhun ma las grub rmig pa bzhis// rdzu 'phrul gom pa bskyod mthong dri khyer yang*// myur mgyogs grags pa'i gtam de brdzun dogs nas// dngos med brdzu la da ltar zhugs min nam// de tshe yid 'phrog ser bu shugs drag gis// rnga rngog bskyod mdzes shel gyi srad bu'i grangs// bsgyur bgod ri mos grangs 'dzin bye bas kyang*// bgrang bar ma bzod stan la ngal stegs byas// gang 'di sna tshogs rin chen phra tshom dang*// phyang phrul sil sil sgra ldan sga srab kyis// spras tshe brgya byin theg pa'i mdzes sdug kyang*// nyams par dogs nas nags tshal stug por yibs// snyan snyan tshig gis lan brgyar bsngags pas kyang*// mang mang ngo mtshar brjod dka' rlung gshog rta// dkar dkar dar gyi cod paṇa ngom bzhin du// khrig khrig gom stabs stong du bsgyur te song*// ces pa sde dge bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa nas/

sa skyong bsod nams mgon por chibs pa 'bul du btang ba'i 'phrin yig sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris so// // ༄༅// skal bzang 'chi ba med pa'i grong khyer nas// rnam dkar dge tshogs yid gcugs mdza' na bos// sde bzhi'i dga' ston mgron du gnyer byas pa'i// dge brtson mi yi lha de'i zhabs stegs drung*// sa bdag rigs kyi dal 'byor ljon pa des// rab dga'i yal ga phyogs der brkyangs nas ni// brtse gdung sems kyi me tog bkra ba las// zhu ris ge sar 'dzum pa'i mdangs bkra ba// dge tshogs shar ri'i rtse mor mngon 'char ba'i// dregs ldan gtsug na bsngags 'os sku'i zla ba// rnam dkar mdzad pa'i bsil zer stong 'phro ba'i// grags pa'i kun+da phyogs kyi khor yug dkar// gang tshe gzugs sku mi shigs rdo rje'i khams// sgrub pa'i bcud len tshe mtha' yas pa yis// khyed la byin par ma bzod nyi ma'i bu// rim bdun rkang pa'i 'og tu cis ma bros// 'di na khams gsum 'gro ba spyi'i nor bu// rang re'i bsod nams thag pas legs zin pa// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos mkhyen brtse'i gter// mkhan chen bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gang dang*// gang de'i drin gyi 'do li la brten nas// bstan pa'i khang bzang du phyin brtul zhugs pa'ang*// 'byung tshogs lus kyi khang bu'i mi mthun phyogs// nyer 'tsho'i dri bzhon gzhan du 'phyan pa'i skabs// yangs pa'i 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag pa'i// bstan jus ring du dar zhing bsod nams kyi// dpag bsam sdong po skyed du bsring ba'i ched// 'dus pa'i tshogs su bsnyen bkur bgyid cing mchis// gnam lo 'brug gi skyes bu gsar tshes kyi// bzhin ras mthong 'di shis pa'i dga' ston du// bzhes bya'i gro dang sha thud bu ram sbrang*// ka ra shing thog rigs te bza' bca'i phon// por thegs rnam par nyams pa'i skyon spong du// rnam gsal rtags kyi re khās sgeg pa 'di// las bzang gser gyi skud pas sbrel ba'i spun// sa spyod dbang po shis pa'i rten 'brel du// ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang sogs// legs bris tshogs kyi skal bzang dum bu zhig

/'di na yongs su 'phos 'drar shis pa'i dbyangs// rgyal ba kun gyis khyed la sgrogs gyur cig /ces pa'i shis brjod dang bcas sgra brgya pa'i// gnam lo'i zla bdag rang gi bus mtshan pa'i// dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dus dge bar// lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab nyid nas phul// zhes pa 'di ni sa skyong sde dge bla chen nas dpon bsod nams mgon po'i drung du lo gsar gyi dga' ston 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad me tog phreng mdzes zhes pa 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// swasti/ gangs ldan ri bos bskor ba'i ljongs// sde bzhis sgeg pa'i sa stengs 'dir// dge bcu'i bka' khrims 'khor los sgyur// byams ldan mi bdag khri drung du// bdag lus sdong bu ldem pa las// thal sbyar me tog dgod pa dang*// snyan ngag tshig gi bh+ra ma ras// skabs don gsol ba'i dbyangs chung 'bul// deng dus 'gro ba'i bsod nams zong*// mang pos mngon par bsgrubs pa'i sku// sems can kun gyi re ba dag /'gengs pa'i lha gcig dpag bsam gang*// bstan srid mi dman dbu 'phang dag /srid pa'i rtse mor bstod pa la// lha khyod sku 'tsho mi shigs pa'i// ka ba brtan por tshugs la rags// de yang sangs rgyas sras bcas la// mchod cing gsung rab sgrogs pa dang*// dge 'dun mnyes las 'byung ba gang*// legs par mkhyen nas deng gi dus// gdon bya sku yi rim gro rnams// ji ltar bka' stsal phebs pa bzhin// snyom las kha lo sgyur chen gyi// dbang du ma song grub par bgyis// gang dag grub pa'i rnam grangs kyang*// rnam par 'joms gzungs khri tshar lnga// sgrol ma'i bstod pa khri phrag bcu// 'don pa'i zhabs tog rtsol bas bsgrubs// dge ba des ni sa spyod mchog /rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i sa bdag bzhin// kun las rnam rgyal smon lam gyi// mthun 'gyur rgyal ba kun sgrogs shig

/gus ldan yid kyi rdzing bu las// legs skyes tshig gi me tog 'di// thugs rje'i grib ma'i 'tsho ba pa// don grub ces byas rten bcas phul// zhes pa 'di'ang sa spyod bsod nams mgon po'i sku zhabs su zhabs brtan grub pa'i snyan sgron 'bul ba'i zhu yig tu ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
